newsitems.title: 7 Days Until Launch! + Demo V5 Update
newsitems.author: Vivi 笑笑
newsitems.contents: Only 7 Days Until the Official Release! 🎉Hello, Guild Masters! The official release of 《Creator Chronicles》 has finally entered its final countdown! Ahead of the official release, we’ve also prepared a major content update for Demo V5.This update introduces new difficulty options and additional save slots, along with a wide range of improvements and adjustments to production, the town economy, class skills, dungeon combat, UI, and controls. Check out the details below.## Game Progression & Saves- Added a new difficulty where monster stats are 60% of the existing difficulty level. - Expanded the number of save slots to 5. Existing demo save data will automatically be migrated to the first slot. - Reorganized the early quest progression and reduced the number of items/requirements needed for Discoveries.## Production, Town & Economy- Guild members and visitors now produce items faster as they level up. At level 60, production time is reduced by up to an additional 30%. - Improved manual production so that specific failure reasons are displayed, such as insufficient town level, missing materials, or reaching the target quantity. - Fixed related town skills, such as Quick Crafting and Continuous Watering, so they are properly applied when production is performed directly by the Guild Master. - Part-time jobs now automatically select a guild member with the required profession. Clicking another guild member immediately switches the selected worker. A notification and the amount of gold earned are also displayed when the job is completed. - Land purchases must now continue from tiles that share an edge with an already unlocked town area. - The number of Auction House listings now scales with town level, ranging from 1 to a maximum of 12. Listing durations are now determined between 11 and 14 days. - Adjusted auction market prices so they respond more naturally to purchases and sold-out items, and softened the rapid return to normal prices after events end.## Class Skill Balance- Adjusted the balance of the Steadfast Companion stage for several guild members. - Increased the coefficients of the Warrior's main attack skills by approximately 10%. Rage now grants 8 Haste per stack instead of 5 and can stack up to 8 times. - Increased the coefficients of the Mage's Ice Arrow, Fireball, and Burn, as well as the Warlock's Dark Orb and Incinerate. - Buffed the Druid's Starfire, Plague, Gift of the Wild, Tranquility, and Enlightenment. Tranquility now also provides an immediate heal and can no longer be cast multiple times simultaneously. - Increased the damage coefficients of the Priest's Penance and Purification, and readjusted the cooldowns and mana costs of major healing and support skills. - Fixed an issue where the Rogue's Vital Strike applied the critical damage multiplier twice to its bonus critical damage, and reduced the Haste gained per critical hit from Focused Attack. - Buffed the Hunter's Rapid Fire to grant 300 Haste for 20 seconds.## Dungeons & Combat- On difficulties without permanent departure rules, parties can now enter dungeons without filling every available party slot. - A warning is now displayed before departure if the party includes a guild member below the recommended minimum level. - Each party preset now displays its currently active dungeon individually. You can also copy and paste supply settings between different presets for the same dungeon. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V shortcuts are supported. - Improved guild member AI so they choose food appropriate for their role and stats. - Health and mana recovery potions are now prioritized for classes that actually use them, while also taking dungeon strategy usage conditions and available potion stock into account. - If a well-prepared party repeatedly loses in a dungeon, they can now obtain one of the remaining dungeon hints. - Dungeon records now store and display only the 10 most recent runs. However, statistics used for Discovery conditions, such as total clears and deathless clears, will continue to accumulate separately. - Skill Book Pages are now displayed correctly in dungeon obtainable-item lists, and undiscovered skills and Skill Books now show either a description or a ? indicator. - Improved post-combat cleanup so remaining simulations and logs are processed more quickly. The View Log button on the results screen can now reopen and close the results panel. - Skills now consume cooldowns and mana only when they are successfully cast. No resources are consumed if there is no valid target or if the skill's conditions are not met. - Improved combat time processing so combat results, cooldowns, and 5-second mana regeneration remain consistent even when game speed and combat tick processing rates differ. - Area-of-effect skills now roll critical hits separately for each target, while equipment effects triggered on skill cast activate only once per cast. - Fixed dungeon travel so conflicting town tasks are properly interrupted when travel begins, and g...

newsitems.title: 📢 Officially Launches on September 14! New Content & Demo Update Revealed
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Hello, Guild Masters! We’re finally ready to share the news you’ve been waiting for. Our game will officially launch on September 14, 2026 at 08:00 UTC 🎉🎉🎉Since releasing our first demo, followed by the CBT and subsequent demo updates, we’ve received an incredible amount of valuable feedback from players.We’ve carefully reviewed your feedback one by one, adding new content to make the game more fun while continuously improving combat, progression, UI, balance, and quality-of-life features. We’re incredibly excited to finally show you the results of everything we’ve been working on.Thank you so much for your patience and for waiting with us all this time. Ahead of the official launch, we’ve also released a new demo update featuring additional improvements. With this update, we focused not only on adding new features and content, but also on reducing repetitive downtime during gameplay and improving the overall responsiveness and feel of the controls. Below, you can find an overview of the new content coming in the full release as well as the major changes included in the latest demo update.🌟 New Content in the Full ReleaseThe full release introduces a variety of new systems and content. From managing your guild members’ moods to testing your skills against other Guild Masters, even more adventures and challenges await you.Tavern System added — Talk with guild members at the Tavern and help manage their mood.Hall of Battle added — Compete in PvP battles against parties raised by other Guild Masters.Ranking & Season Systems added — Challenge yourself to achieve the best records across a variety of categories.With this new content, guild management, party development, and competitive gameplay will become even more rewarding. We hope every Guild Master will be able to find their own goals and challenges to pursue.We hope you enjoy all the new content! 📜Demo Update Patch Notes💝 Character Affinity SystemA new Affinity System has been added, allowing you to build deeper relationships with your guild members.You can increase Affinity by giving items as gifts. As you grow closer, you’ll discover new sides of each guild member and unlock a variety of benefits.Increase Affinity with guild members by giving them itemsRelationship changes based on Affinity levelUnlock various synergy effects at higher Affinity levelsA new progression element that goes beyond simply developing your guild members by letting you build relationships with them as wellShow some attention to your favorite guild members and strengthen your bonds with them.Guild members you grow closer to will support you in many different ways throughout your adventures and guild management.⚔️ Party Strategy SettingsWe’ve added a new Party Strategy feature that gives you more control over how each party behaves in combat.Previously, party members acted according to predefined conditions during battle. Now, you can customize potion usage and combat behavior to better suit each party’s composition and purpose.Added potion usage settings for each partyAdded healing settings for each partyAdded attack settings for each partyYou can now create and use different strategies depending on your party composition and the content you’re taking on.⏱️ Reduced Waiting TimesDuring the early stages of the game, waiting for production and crafting could sometimes interrupt the flow of gameplay.With this update, we’ve revisited the pacing of early-game progression and reduced situations where players had little to do except wait.Adjusted early-game hub production speedsRebalanced the time required for manual craftingReduced unnecessary waiting during early-game progression 🛒 Auction House ImprovementsThe Auction House is more than just a place to buy and sell items—it is one of the core systems driving the in-game economy.In this update, we’ve adjusted the pricing structure and overall economic balance so that trading activity and market conditions are reflected more naturally in actual market prices.Improved the system so item purchases and sales are reflected in market price changesUnsold listings now affect market pricesThe quantity of items supplied to the market now affects price fluctuationsAdjusted overall Auction House pricing and economic balanceAs prices now respond more dynamically to market conditions, deciding when to buy and sell items will play a more meaningful role than before.🎨 Intro Illustration ImprovementsWe’ve polished the intro illustrations that appear when you first begin the game.We improved transitions that previously felt awkward between scenes, allowing the story to flow more naturally.Revised the overall art style of the intro illustrationsImproved transitions and presentation between scenes 🖥️ UI/UX & Controls ImprovementsWe’ve refined the overall UI and controls to reduce the number of repeated inputs required for frequently used features and make it faster to set precise values.In particular, we focused on improving usability for settings that play...

newsitems.title: 🌟 Thank You for 30,000 Wishlists! + CBT Results Update
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Hello, Guild Masters. This is Origin Studio.Thanks to your interest and support, our game has reached 30,000 wishlists on Steam!Receiving so much anticipation for a game that has not yet been released has been a tremendous source of encouragement for our development team. We sincerely thank everyone who visited our Steam page, added the game to their wishlist, and shared support and feedback through the community.To express our gratitude, we would like to share part of the survey results from our recent private CBT, as well as the improvements our development team is currently working on.CBT Survey ResultsThis CBT was conducted privately with around 30 participants from 7 countries.The testers played the game firsthand and shared a wide range of opinions and suggestions. Our development team is carefully reviewing each piece of feedback.The most satisfying systems selected by participants were auto-battle and the variety of guild members.Following those, many testers also highlighted the guild member skill-change system, which becomes available after constructing the Magic School, as one of the features they enjoyed.In particular, auto-battle through the Gryphon Landing Pad received positive feedback as a feature that helps reduce fatigue from repeated battles. The process of recruiting and developing a wide variety of guild members was also evaluated positively by many participants.In this CBT, players were able to play up to the first Raid Dungeon.Based on the survey responses, 50% of participants cleared the first Raid Dungeon. The remaining participants responded that they had attempted it but were unable to clear it, or had not yet reached the Raid Dungeon.Regarding the raid, we received many comments such as, “Clearing it felt very rewarding,” and “I’m looking forward to more team dungeons and raids.”Although this content was designed to be quite challenging, we sincerely thank everyone who continued to take on the challenge and managed to clear it.In particular, we would also like to once again congratulate and thank the six players who cleared Conqueror Mode and earned a place on the rankings, despite the risk of their characters being reset to level 1 upon death.That is truly impressive. 👏👏👏👏👏Upcoming Systems in DevelopmentLastly, we also conducted a survey asking which systems the development team should prioritize next.The most requested system was the Bank System.Many players told us that they would like a feature that allows the Guild Master to directly store items and distribute equipment to guild members who need it. In response, the development team is reviewing ways to let players manage equipment and items more actively.The second most requested feature was the Guild Member Mood Management System.During the CBT, some players shared that the process of guild members’ moods declining felt somewhat stressful. In response, the development team is preparing a system that will allow players to manage guild members’ conditions through a new building. We are also reviewing additional interaction elements so that guild members feel less like simple stats and more like living characters.In addition, we received a wide range of feedback, including requests for world map expansion, more interactions with guild members, a monster invasion system, and a PvP system.While we may not be able to reflect every suggestion all at once, we will carefully review all of the feedback you have sent us and use it as an important reference when deciding the direction of development.We Are Also Refining the Existing Play ExperienceWe believe that making the existing play experience more stable is just as important as adding new content. Since the CBT, the development team has been working on improvements focused on the following areas:Adjusting the early-game growth paceImproving mid- to late-game gold and resource balanceAdjusting class-specific skills and mana consumptionImproving the dungeon difficulty curveLocalizationImproving UI readabilityImproving font size and text display issuesBug fixes and optimizationIn particular, many players repeatedly mentioned combat power, equipment growth, and class balance, so we are reviewing these areas with extra care.Finally, Thank You Once AgainWe are also very grateful that, when asked whether they would be willing to play the game after its official release, every survey respondent answered “Yes.”This was an incredibly encouraging result for the development team. At the same time, it also made us feel an even greater sense of responsibility to repay your support with a better game.This CBT was not simply a time for testing the game. It was also a process that allowed the development team to look at the game again from the players’ perspective.There are still many areas that need improvement, but we will continue refining the game based on the feedback you have shared with us.Once again, thank you for helping us reach 30,000 wishlists. We will continue to share our developme...

newsitems.title: Patch Notes ver. 0.11
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Hello, this is Origin Studio.We have identified an issue where gold increases abnormally in certain save data. This issue occurs with save files from older versions. If you start a new game in the current version (0.10), this issue will not occur. To ensure the intended progression balance and preserve the core gameplay experience, we kindly recommend that you delete existing save data and start a new game. Additionally, starting from the next update, a “Hall of Fame” system will be introduced, and rankings will be reset by version. Therefore, this gold issue will not affect future rankings. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused, and we will continue working to provide a more stable gaming experience.Thank you.

newsitems.title: Development Progress & Demo Update
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Development Progress and Demo UpdateGreetings, Guild Masters! We are back with our fifth update news. In this update, we have developed the new 'Raid System' as promised in our previous roadmap, and we have improved combat convenience and the overall UI by reflecting the valuable feedback you've shared with us. Our journey toward completing an even better game continues.🗺️ Dungeon Auto-RunIncluded in the Early Access version. As it is approximately Level 40 content, it is not available in the demo.The "Auto-Battle Dispatch" feature, which many Guild Masters have consistently requested, has been added. Once you construct the Griffin Rider Base, the Auto-Run feature becomes active. By setting up party presets, you can progress through dungeons automatically. Presets now store supply data separately for each party, and you can control which dungeons to prioritize through priority settings.By learning the \ village skill, low-level guild members can now level up even when clearing dungeons alongside high-level members. - Auto-Run activated upon constructing the Griffin Rider Base- Separate storage for supply data per party- Added \ village skill🏆 Quest & Achievement OverhaulWe received a lot of feedback stating that it was difficult to grasp the overall flow and goals of the game. In this update, we have completely overhauled the Quest and Achievement systems. We have revised the overall quests so that new Guild Masters can learn the game naturally as they start.- The Crow NPC now appears from the early game to guide your progress- Core quest content can now be viewed via video- Achievements have been split into individual goals, allowing you to track quest progress even after completion🧠 Guild Member Mood SystemGuild members are not just tools. Each has their own mood and personality. If you neglect their management, production efficiency and combat power may drop, they may cause friction with colleagues, or in extreme cases, they may leave the guild without notice. Managing the hearts of your guild members is just as important a strategy as building a strong party.- Guild members' moods change based on various situations such as dungeon deployment, death of a colleague, or returning to town.- Stats and profession efficiency may increase or decrease depending on the mood level.- If the mood level drops below a certain point, a guild member may leave the guild permanently.⚔️ Raid System (In Progress)The Raid System previewed in the roadmap makes its first appearance. This content is currently under implementation, and we plan to increase its polish through future updates.Over 30 types of dedicated Raid Bosses will be added, each requiring a different strategy. - Clearing raids allows you to obtain high-grade rewards not available in regular dungeons.- A Replay feature has been added to analyze the causes of defeat by reviewing combat logs after a battle ends.🎲 World EventsThe village is no longer a static space. Sometimes sudden events shake up Auction House prices, and the mood of guild members can shift the atmosphere of the entire town. A World Event system has been added, allowing various in-game situations to influence the village and economy in real-time.- Events are triggered by various conditions such as guild member mood, level-ups, and village growth.📜 Other Major Changes📈 Balance- Rebalanced early-game gold acquisition and the prices of houses and fields- Dynamic Auction House item price changes during World Events- Overall rebalancing of Hero drop rates, dungeon monster attack range, and potions- Adjusted the playable range of the Demo version🖥️ UI/UX- Improved display of character classes (Tank/DPS/Healer)- Resource acquisition now displays colors according to item grade- Improved the direction of damage text output- Added outline effects on mouse hover- Improved design for the Dungeon Info window, Achievement system, and bottom tab menu- Added individual volume controls for BGM and SFX- Added Shortcut UI and Credits UI- Added floating gold deduction display when constructing buildings- Completely rewrote logic for preset creation, deletion, and auto-selection- Added auto-delete for 0 presets and auto-select when only 1 preset exists- Added party colors to distinguish presets- Added a Pause screen when pausing with the Spacebar⚙️ Performance- Reflecting feedback from Guild Masters using lower-end devices, we have improved settings to allow individual disabling of certain visual effects and heavy features. We will continue to optimize the game to ensure a pleasant experience in various environments.- Improved overall performance through architectural enhancements- Fixed numerous stability bugs discovered during various tests🐛 Bug Fixes (Major)- Strengthened save recovery logic and maintained up to 10 daily backups- Fixed a critical bug where potion cooldowns were shared between dungeon instances- Fixed a bug where dozens of duplicate items were created in the Auction House- Fixed a bug where the vil...

newsitems.title: Difficulty Update: New “Beginner” & “Conqueror” Modes Added!
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Patch Notes ver. 0.07Hello, Guild Master! 🌞Our fourth small update has arrived!Among your feedback, many pointed out that “it feels frustrating when a guild member’s level resets to 1 upon death.” Originally, this was designed to emphasize tension and careful decision-making in Hardcore mode, but we realized that many players found it more stressful than fun.Therefore, we have split the difficulty into two modes: “Beginner” and “Conqueror.”■ Beginner Recommended for those who want to enjoy the game comfortably without major challenges.No penalty when a guild member dies.Guild members will not permanently quit the game.Cleared runs do not appear on the global ranking board.■ ConquerorRecommended for those who enjoy the thrill of challenge and achievement.If a guild member dies in battle, their level resets to 1.A guild member may permanently leave the game depending on their mood. Departed members cannot be re-invited.Player vs. Player combat is available in the Arena.Clear times are recorded on the global leaderboard.The “Your Chronicle” event applies only to Conqueror mode.We carefully read all your feedback and truly appreciate your input.We’ll keep improving to deliver an even better gameplay experience. Thank you so much for your continued support! 🙏📕 ChangesAdded difficulty options: Beginner and Conqueror are now selectable.Partial translation updates for German, Japanese, and English based on native speaker feedback.👾 Bug FixesFixed an issue where the in-game date was not calculated correctly after one year.Improved pathfinding and overall performance for low-end systems.Fixed lag (1–2 seconds) caused by having too many guild member chronicles.Fixed a bug where guild members or visitors claimed there was no path despite one existing.Fixed an issue where volume settings were not applied correctly when starting or exiting the game.🔥 Ongoing FixesThe issue where characters fail to return from dungeons has multiple causes. Some have been resolved, but others are still under investigation. If your party remains stuck after this patch, please send us your save file via the \ feature — it greatly helps us! 🙏Thank you for joining us on this journey to make “Creator Chronicles” an even better game!

newsitems.title: Patch Notes ver. 0.06
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: \Hello, Guild Masters! 🌞\Our third minor update has arrived! We’ve implemented several quality-of-life improvements and made adjustments to item prices based on your feedback. We always listen closely to your opinions and will continue striving to make the game even better.Every piece of feedback you share is carefully reviewed. Thank you sincerely for your continued support. 🙏\📕 Changes\Added a Party Preset feature so you won’t have to select the same guild members every time.Added Shift + Click continuous building functionality.Added Shift + Click continuous road removal functionality.Increased the price of most resources by 3–5×, and purchase prices by 2–5×.Changed housing behavior so guild members stay fixed at the location you build, rather than searching for an optimal spot themselves.Improved Auction House purchase UI — items can now be bought more easily via a slider. Increased the time early heroes stay in town.\👾 Bug Fixes\Fixed an issue where crops overlapped or displayed incorrectly.Fixed an issue where items purchased at the Auction House sometimes did not appear in the inventory.Fixed an issue on macOS where the UI initialized before Steam, causing double-clicks to be required.Fixed an issue where houses did not stay in their intended positions.Fixed an issue where some Chinese text did not display correctly.\🔥 Ongoing Fixes\The issue where characters fail to return after entering a dungeon has been found to result from multiple complex factors. Some causes have been fixed, but others remain under investigation. If this issue still occurs after this update, please use the \ feature to send us your save data via email — it greatly helps us track down and resolve the problem. 🙏\Update – October 17, 2025\Items can now be obtained at a low probability even from part-time jobs.Fixed an issue where the resolution order was sometimes applied incorrectly.The game now safely saves progress even after long play sessions when returning to the main menu.Fixed a bug that prevented the road construction quest from completing.Fixed a bug where low-level heroes could join high-level heroes in a preset and enter higher-level dungeons.Thank you for joining us on the journey to make 〈Creator Chronicles〉 an even better game!

newsitems.title: Patch Notes ver. 0.05
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Hello, Guild Master! 🌞 Our second small update has arrived. Based on your feedback, we made slight difficulty adjustments. These are not major balance patches that affect records, only improvements to prevent unfair party wipes. We continue to listen carefully to your feedback and work hard to create a better game. We are reviewing all your feedback without missing any. Thank you sincerely. 📕Changes Added preparations that can be taken into dungeons in the demo to adjust difficulty, Corrected some popup tooltip texts, Lowered production level requirement for early resistance potions, 👾Bug Fixes Fixed bug where certain areas could not be planted after growing crops for a long time, Fixed incorrect condition for discovering the 30th guild member (White Wolf Citadel → Abandoned Mine), Fixed bug where outlines were not displayed on some buildings, Fixed bug where alarm window blocked clicks, 🔥Ongoing Fixes The issue where characters cannot return after entering dungeons is caused by multiple combined conditions. Some have been fixed, but unresolved causes remain. If party members still get stuck in dungeons after this patch, sending your save data via \ will greatly help us resolve the issue. Thank you for being with as we make it a better game! 2025-09-30 Additional FixModified so that if a guild member dies, they will not leave the guild unless they quit the game.Improved the issue where players could not return from dungeons.Fixed Chinese UI and some fonts.Improved in-game logs.Added backup save function in addition to cloud save.

newsitems.title: Help the developer
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Hello, Guild Master! Thank you sincerely for the great interest and support you’ve shown since the demo release. Although we wanted to present a highly polished demo after thorough QA, some bugs that we had not discovered are now being reported. To identify the exact cause and resolve the issues quickly, please send us the save file from the path below if you encounter a bug. C:\\Users\\YourPcName\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Origin Studio ✉️ Mail originstudiokr@gmail.com We will fix the issues as quickly as possible and apply the corrections in updates. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused during gameplay, and we will do our best to resolve the problems quickly. Thank you always for your valuable feedback and reports.

newsitems.title: Patch Notes ver. 0.04
newsitems.author: Origin Studio
newsitems.contents: Hello, Guild Master! 🌞 Our very first update has just arrived!Thanks to the detailed feedback you’ve shared since the demo release, we’ve been able to clearly see what worked well and what caused inconvenience. We know feedback takes valuable time and effort, so we truly appreciate the thoughts you’ve shared with us. We’ll keep doing our best to apply your suggestions and make the game even better. Thank you sincerely!(Since English isn’t our native language, some of our earlier translations may have sounded awkward. We’ll be reviewing them more carefully moving forward, but if you notice anything odd, please let us know—we’ll fix it as quickly as possible!)📕 ChangesAdded new quests and updated some textRoad construction and removal made easierNew layer filter: when selecting a road, all buildings are shown semi-transparentCorrected English translation of the Auction House questImproved translations that could cause confusionNumber formatting updated to use the “k” notation (familiar outside of Asia)Fixed issue where message bubbles blocked clicksAdded tooltip description to the item lock buttonMade meat item descriptions more detailedWhen no guild members are available for part-time jobs, a message will now display: “No guild members available”After constructing a building, move and demolish icons no longer appear immediatelyReduced cases where dungeon expeditions failed due to missing supplies or skilled members being busy with professions👾 Bug FixesFixed occasional bug where the main screen was cut off on the sidesFixed bug where locked items were still being usedFixed bug where portraits after reset showed the previous characterFixed bug where planting herbs simultaneously with a herbalist and the mouse caused plants to appear incorrectFixed bug where high-level guild members could still die during part-time jobs🔥 Currently Being FixedWe’re investigating an issue where characters sometimes don’t return after being sent to dungeons. We’re working hard to resolve this as quickly as possible. If you can let us know which dungeon you sent them to and what party composition you used, it will be a huge help in solving the problem!Thank you for joining us on the journey to make a better game!2025-09-27 Additional Fixes Fixed a bug where roads were selected twice in the construction tab. Fixed a bug where guild members would stop if a building was moved while they were cooking. Fixed a bug where guild members would return home after the game was paused for a long time. Fixed a bug where buildings could not be built even in valid locations.Fixed a bug where commonly used characters could not be used in IDs during character creation.Fixed a critical bug where the village entrance was intermittently blocked, preventing construction, trading, and game progress.
